text:
Predicates:
Capital(x, y) ::: x is the capital of y.
PopulousNation(x) ::: x is the world's most populous nation.
LocatedIn(x, y) ::: x is located in y.
Hosted(x, y) ::: x hosted y.
SummerOlympics(y) ::: y is the Summer Olympics.
WinterOlympics(y) ::: y is the Winter Olympics.
Paralympics(y) ::: y is the Paralympics.
Premises:
Capital(beijing, china) ::: Beijing is the capital of the People's Republic of China.
Capital(beijing, populousNation) ::: Beijing is the capital city of the world's most populous nation.
LocatedIn(beijing, northernChina) ::: Beijing is located in Northern China.
Hosted(beijing, summerOlympics2008) ∧ Hosted(beijing, summerParalympics2008) ::: Beijing hosted the 2008 Summer Olympics and 2008 Summer Paralympics Games.
∃y (SummerOlympics(y) ∧ Hosted(beijing, y)) ∧ ∃z (WinterOlympics(z) ∧ Hosted(beijing, z)) ∧ ∃w (Paralympics(w) ∧ Hosted(beijing, w)) ::: Beijing has hosted the Summer and Winter Olympics and the Summer and Winter Paralympics.
Conclusion:
Hosted(beijing, summerOlympics2008) ∧ ∃z (WinterOlympics(z) ∧ Hosted(beijing, z)) ::: Beijing hosted both the 2008 Summer Olympics and the Winter Olympics.
